claims.claim: An orphaned effect_pending tool call is replayed only when the persisted call policy and the current tool declaration are both replay-safe and the run was not cancelled.
When replay is not admitted, recovery publishes an interrupted outcome that carries the durable checkpoint content, details, and usage, without clearing the checkpoint or invoking the tool.
The original fault admitted replay when either declaration was safe, so recovery cleared the checkpoint and invoked a tool whose current declaration was absent, unsafe, or missing.

validation.notes: Repaired recoverToolInvocation in packages/agent/src/harness/runtime/drive/tools.ts: replay admission changed from `!cancelled && (call.replay === "safe" || tool?.replay === "safe")` to `!cancelled && call.replay === "safe" && tool?.replay === "safe"`, matching the durable contract that both the persisted call policy and the current tool declaration must be safe. The standalone assertion script loads the real production module through .prale-eval/subject.mjs with boundary fakes for checkpoint clear/read, tool invocation, and outcome publication. It asserts the replay path (both safe, not cancelled => clear, invoke, effect-complete, publish) and, for every single-safe or unsafe combination (stored safe with tool absent/without policy/never, stored never with current safe, both never) plus the cancelled case, asserts only checkpoint read then publish with preserved checkpoint content, details, and usage, the interruption marker appended, isError true, and no checkpoint clear or tool invocation. Failure evidence on the original fault: before the fix, the 'stored safe + tool absent' case produced events ['clear','invoke','effect-complete','publish'] and failed the deepStrictEqual assertion against ['read','publish']; after the fix the same command exits zero. The repository vitest suite could not be run because node_modules is not installed and installing dependencies is out of scope; the regression uses only Node 24 built-ins (node:assert, node:vm via subject.mjs) and needs no network.
